name: domain-mcp
description: Manage Dynadot domains, DNS, WHOIS, nameservers, transfers, and aftermarket through MCP.
long_description: Domain MCP exposes 108 Dynadot operations through 13 AI-native tools for Claude, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and other MCP-compatible clients. It supports domain registration and renewal, DNS and DNSSEC, WHOIS contacts, nameservers and glue records, transfers, account settings, folders, orders, aftermarket operations, focused availability checks, domain idea generation, and credential-free local help.

dynadot_api_key.description: Optional Dynadot API key. Tool discovery and local help work without it; registrar operations return an actionable configuration error until provided.
